title: App Studio 改版（4-2）：散落项按勾选「移入软件包」——新入口逐项过保存检查、整批判引用；收编散落项接口和 Studio「组织的流程」同时下线（关 #37468）
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzywxH36FPH6ayWMUe

Filing gate: ③ · Source: topic #37424 (ruling 7184753035, question 3 answered C, the maintainer's 「同意」 of 2026-11-26T06:44Z; ADR-0084 `#amendment-2026-11-26-org`, "Loose items stay where they are, and one door moves them"); #37468's fix shape, ruled in comment 7184767608. Phase order: the ruling fixes only "UI ask and kernel close in the same phase, kernel last". This card's middle slot, after #38149 and before the kernel-close card (filed after decisions Q-g is answered), comes from the takeover plan (#37424 comment 7216856007), not from a ruling. Sub-issue of #37424 (phase 4). Closes #37468, with PR-B: the ruling's "three regression tests, the old route and both menu entries removed" is complete only there. When this card is cut, the seat rewrites #37468's `Blocked-by:` line to name it (#37468 comment 7213077829).
Grade: area:ux · Feature · p2 · evidence: read on origin/main 815e882b and rechecked at 581ae76a: none of the cited files moved between them, and they are unchanged since 7e4df284. The door, its judges, both UI entries and the `~org` scope were read in code. #37468's three defects were measured by the #37453 probe at a46efa8c, and the code they rest on is unchanged.
Reader: a seat card thread (seat repo:objectstack#3, zone `o3-studio`, with the package zone's files: `packages/runtime`, `packages/metadata-protocol`, `packages/spec`, `packages/client`).
- **Build tier:** the default judgment tier, for both PRs.
- **Review tier:** the contract-review tier, owed by surface (`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs:13260–13275`).
- **PR-A widens** the public surface: a new route, its request and response schemas, a dry-run form and an SDK method. By that rule, PR-A is spec-lane work "whichever seat found it". The seat hands PR-A to the spec lane, or records on the card why it builds PR-A itself. PR-A declares `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and is reviewed at the contract-review tier, because it adds published schemas.
- **PR-B narrows** the surface: it removes `POST /api/v1/packages/:id/adopt-orphans`, the SDK method `packages.adoptOrphans`, and the published spec export `ReassignOrphanedMetadataResponseSchema`. PR-B is BREAKING and declares `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` with an ADR-0087 disposition. It owes one contract-review-tier review before the queue.
- **Declaration lines.** The claim comment carries one `Clause-②:` line (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:315`), so each PR body carries its own line. The cleaner alternative is two cards: 4-2a (the widening) and 4-2b (the narrowing, `Blocked-by` 4-2a), with the kernel-close card blocked by 4-2b. The seat picks one.
- PR-A needs no maintainer word and can start now. PR-B waits for decisions Q-f, which the seat put back to the maintainer on 2026-11-28: if answered E, What 7 joins PR-B; otherwise What 7 drops and #38061 follows its own answer.
Dedupe: searched `"move into package"`, `adopt-orphans`, `reassignOrphanedMetadata`, `"loose items"` (issues, open and closed). Hits:
- #37468, closed by this card;
- #37453, the census;
- #24813, #28776, #28735, #23646, #23690 and #37604: earlier adopt-orphans patches, all closed;
- #37401 and #37958 (open): they touch the same Setup → Packages and overview ⋯ surfaces;
- #38061 (open): the cross-package Source badge, coupled to `~org` (decisions Q-f).

None is a selection move door.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：跨软件包的列表里多一个「散落项」筛选，可以勾选一个、几个或全部散落项，点「移入软件包」，选好软件包后一次移进去。移不进去的会逐条说明原因，例如对象名没有那个软件包的前缀。原来「一次全收」的「收编散落项」按钮，和 Studio 菜单里「组织的流程」入口，同时下线。设置的「软件包」页上会显示「有 N 个散落项」，点进去就能找到它们。
- 为什么：你裁定散落项原地保留，由一个按勾选来移动的入口负责移入；每一项都要过保存时的检查，整批一起判断引用关系。旧接口实测有三个缺陷：能收编进没安装的软件包；收编后对象存不了；流程和数据集要重启才换地址。这张卡用回归测试把它们关掉。
- 需要你做的：第一步（新入口）现在就开工，不需要你裁。第二步（删掉旧接口和「组织的流程」入口）要等你回答决策稿的 Q-f：选 E，这一步顺带把来源标签改对。这张卡同时新增一个公开接口、删掉一个旧接口（删接口属于破坏性变更），合并前两半都要合约审查；架构决定记录上的标注由你合并。

## Ruled (not reopened)

- Ruling 7184753035, question 3 (C), verbatim: "Existing loose items stay where they are (ADR-0150 D1 bucket 4: environment-authored rows belong to the implicit environment package, no rename, no migration). One new "move into package" door takes a selection (one, several or all) and runs each item through the save door's judges, judging the selection as a set for the ADR-0150 D3 (a) cross-boundary rule; it reuses the existing list page. `adopt-orphans` and the Studio `~org` entry retire at once when it ships. This supersedes the parent's per-item sorting page (task 10) and the earlier one-shot-migration recommendation."
- Same record: "#37468's three defects close with that door (each a regression test); `reassignOrphanedMetadata` is not patched."
- #37468 comment 7184767608: "This card closes with that door's PR (the three cases as regression tests, the old route and both menu entries removed); ⛔ do not patch `reassignOrphanedMetadata` in place."
- ADR-0084 `#amendment-2026-11-26-org`: "Where the new door is opened from is its card's to say." and "The ⋯ menu keeps "adopt loose items" until then, and loses it then."
- #37424 task 10 and decision 12's sorting page are superseded by the ruling above. Not built.

## Measured on main

### The door that retires: `adopt-orphans`

1. **Route.** `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts:4026–4067`.
   - Gates: `requireManageMetadata`, the walled refusal, the knowledge-source gate, the no-query refusal, `requireWritablePackage` (4051).
   - The comment at 4042–4050 says it on purpose: "An id nothing installed is writable by the predicate's own rule, so it still reaches the protocol" (#37468 A1).
   - Mount: `dispatcher-plugin.ts:1704`. Ledger: `route-ledger.ts:590` (`disposition: 'sdk'`, `packages.adoptOrphans`). SDK: `packages/client/src/index.ts:3621`.
   - Spec: `ReassignOrphanedMetadataResponseSchema`, `packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts:370–378`. It is a published export, listed in `packages/spec/{api-surface,json-schema.manifest,authorable-surface,declaration-map,export-origins}/api.json`.
   - Protocol method: `protocol.ts:10687–10697`.
2. **Body.** `ProtocolPackageCommitsFacet.reassignOrphanedMetadata`, `protocol-package-commits.ts:917–1110`.
   - It takes every package-less row, of every type, active and draft. Excluded: artifact overlays, the platform record, legacy organization-scoped rows (941–954).
   - It judges the object owner, the permission-set owner (959–985) and `__c` (990–1004).
   - It does not judge that the target is installed (A1), the namespace prefix (A2), or child K.
   - It rebinds by a bare `engine.update` (1030–1036). Write-through runs for `view` and `object` only (1049, A3).
3. **UI entries.**
   - `StudioPackageMenu.tsx:240–246`.
   - `PackagesPage.tsx:1118–1132`, 1363–1368 and 1580.
   - `packageActions.tsx:136–155` and 195–232.
   - i18n `engine.packages.detail.adopt*` (`studio/en.ts:2155–2160`, `zh.ts:1949–1955`).
   - `packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-conformance.matrix.ts:281`.
4. **Everything else that names the old door** (grep `adopt-orphans|adoptOrphans|reassignOrphanedMetadata|packages_orphan_adoption`, CHANGELOGs excluded):
   - the spec message key `packages_orphan_adoption_unsupported`, `packages/spec/src/system/operation-message.ts:511, 627, 759, 904` (four locales; dead once the route goes);
   - docs: `content/docs/api/metadata-api.mdx` (177), `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`, `content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx`;
   - `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json:440, 445`;
   - about 35 test files, among them:
     - `packages/client/src/{packages-lifecycle,return-type-precision}.test.ts`;
     - `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.adopt-orphans-*.test.ts` and `…reassign-orphans-durability…`;
     - `packages/objectql/src/protocol-adopt-orphans-*.test.ts`;
     - `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-*.test.ts` (adopt-orphans-readonly, capability-gate, …) and `package-duplicate-adopt-org-scope.integration.test.ts`;
     - `packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.test.ts`;
     - dogfood `package-first-authoring`, `wall-environment-metadata-refusal`, `wall-package-doors-refusal`;
     - UI `PackagesPage.adoptLooseItems-13339`, `installedAppsUpdates-34722`, `moduleDisable-28118`, `readOnlyActions-13157`, `StudioPackageMenu-37139`.

### The `~org` entry that retires

5. **Scope module.** `studio-design/studioScope.ts`: `STUDIO_ORG_SCOPE_SOURCE`, `isStudioOrgScope`, `studioOrgScopePath`, `isPackageLessItem`, `isPackageLessDraft`, `isOrgScopeDraft`. The segment is at `studioAddress.ts:57`.
6. **Where it is drawn.**
   - Menu row: `studioMenuModel.ts:220`, with 167 and 315.
   - Area: `StudioMetadataArea.tsx:444`.
   - Redirects: `metadataArea.ts:249` and 286–311, `automationsPillarRedirect.ts:51`, `studioPillarRedirectModel.ts:89`, `studioSurfaceScope.ts:55`, `ObjectActionsPanel.tsx:256`.
   - Changes row: `StudioTopLeft.tsx:84`. Batch publish: `studioSurfacePublish.ts:149`, `StudioSurfaceFrame.tsx:248`.
   - ADR-0084 names it at lines 234, 298, 414, 420, 456, 476, 505 and 507.
7. **What it lists is not exactly "package-less".**
   - `allLeg` is true there (`ResourceListPage.tsx:301`). It is filtered `?source=runtime`, which its redirect forces.
   - `classifyProvenance` (`ResourceListPage.tsx:194–203`) also files a `.custom` pair item and a served overlay as `runtime`.
   - Through `studioListSource`, that same classification is the Studio list's Source badge (#38061: a classifier change moves authored packages' flows into `~org`, measured in comment 7231630549).
   - The exact predicate is `isPackageLessItem`.
8. **Where the cross-package list is reached today.**
   - The cross-package directory left the Studio menu (`studioMenuModel.ts:36–38`, #37565).
   - Setup's directory lists the access types only (`metadataAreaHost.ts:80`).
   - So once `~org` goes, a flow's loose list is reached only from this card's Setup → Packages banner, or by address.

### The save door's judges

9. **All of them are reached from `saveMetaItemUnaudited`** (`protocol-save.ts:345`):
   - `uninstalledNamedBaseRefusal` (`protocol-package-scope.ts:102`, `422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`);
   - `isWritablePackage` and the D1 block (`protocol-save.ts:2108–2180`);
   - `objectNamespacePrefixViolation` (`protocol-save-door-refusals.ts:967`, `422 NAMESPACE_PREFIX`) and `objectNamespaceObjectNameClash` (987, child K);
   - `classifyObjectContribution` / `overlayPackageMismatchError`;
   - `permissionSetOwnerBindingRefusal` (`protocol-authoring-refusals.ts:203`);
   - `judgeExtensionFieldSuffix`, `overrideWriteVerdict` and `permissionSetNameCollisionRefusal`;
   - `applyRegistryWriteThrough` (`protocol-save.ts:2409`).

   Whether one call can run them with no write is unverified. Today they run inline in the save.
10. **ADR-0150 D3 (a), the set rule.** A package caller never resolves a bare name to an environment item. #37453 §3 measured that after a partial move, a loose dataset answered `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` to `?callerPackage=` of the moved package. Candidate readers: `packages/lint/src/reference-integrity-suite.ts` and `packages/cli/src/utils/stored-package-references.ts`. Whether either runs over stored rows for one selection is unverified.
11. **What a move changes in addresses, as measured on the OLD door** (#37453 §3):
    - `_env/NAME` answered `409` from the next boot, because the old door wrote through for view and object only;
    - the AI face name becomes `NS-NAME` (`packages/spec/src/ai/face-name.ts:86–91`);
    - an unprefixed object can never move into a namespaced package and stays a legal loose item.

    On the new door, which writes through for every type (What 3), the `_env` address likely fails at once. This must be re-measured.
12. **No selection on the list page.** `metadataListState.ts:52`: the source filter is `all | artifact | runtime`. The cross-package leg lists every package's rows of a type (`scopeListRows`, 273–281).

## Readings this card takes (no ruling needed, said so the reviewer can object)

- **Where the door is opened from** (ADR-0084 gives this to the card).
  - (1) On the cross-package list of any type: a new "Loose" source value, row checkboxes, select-all, and a selection bar "Move into package…".
  - (2) A Setup → Packages banner, "N loose items", shown while N is above 0. It opens the cross-package directory with a loose count per type. It is decision 12's placement, kept for the door. With the directory off the Studio menu (item 8), this banner is the menu path to loose items.
  - Not in the package ⋯ menu.
- **"All" means all loose items of one type**: the filtered list's select-all. The server door takes a selection across types, so a flow and the dataset it reads can move together. A set refused under D3 (a) names the loose items it references, and the UI offers to add them. There is no one-click whole-environment move.
- **The package picker** is #38149's ask: writable packages only, plus "create a new one".
- **The `~org` Changes row and its batch publish retire with the entry.** ADR-0084:420 says the row "is drawn on `~org` alone", and "No ruling gives this home: it was built first". Package-less drafts keep two publish paths:
  - Home's Publish all publishes every pending draft, package-less ones by reference (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/usePublishAllDrafts.ts:14–18`, "Package-less drafts fall back to by-reference publish … so they never dead-end"; 97–98; 144–165; `HomePage.tsx:406, 428`);
  - each item page's publish and discard (`ResourceEditPage.tsx:3317–3345`).

  (An earlier draft asked this as Q-c on a wrong premise. It is not a question.)

## What

Two PRs, merged back to back in one release, unless the seat rules one PR or two cards. Declarations allow at most one arm per PR.

Reading (not a ruling): the ruling retires the old door "at once when it ships". With two PRs, both doors exist on main between the merges, so PR-A must not ship in a release without PR-B.

**PR-A, the new door (`Clause-②: yes (widening)`, spec lane).**
1. **Server door.** `POST /api/v1/packages/:id/move-in`. The spelling is the card's, and the route ledger, spec schemas and SDK method follow it. Body: `{ items: [{ type, name, member? }] }`.
   - Gates as `adopt-orphans` has them.
   - The target must be installed and writable, judged by the save door's own predicates (A1: `422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`).
   - Only package-less items are movable, with today's exclusions. Any other item is refused per item.
2. **Judge, then write, all or nothing.**
   - Phase one runs the save door's judges (item 9) for PKG, never a copy of them. If they cannot answer without writing, factor them into one callable shared by both doors.
   - Then the D3 (a) set rule: every bare-name reference resolves from PKG plus the selection.
   - Any refusal refuses the whole call, with per-item codes, and nothing is written.
3. **Write.** Rebind active and draft rows, then the save door's write-through for every type (A3). Record a package commit (unverified that `recordPackageCommit` takes a move).
4. **Answer and confirm.** The answer lists the moved items, and per item what changed: the `_env` address and the AI face name. The confirm step reads them from a judge-only call (`?dryRun=true` or equivalent). **Re-measure the `_env` wording on this door** (item 11). Do not copy the old door's "stops resolving at the next boot".
5. **UI.**
   - The "Loose" source value, filtered by `isPackageLessItem` exactly, never `classifyProvenance`.
   - A checkbox column under that filter on the cross-package leg.
   - The selection bar, the picker, the confirm, and per-item refusals.
   - The Setup → Packages banner with per-type counts (a new read, or one list read per type; the card measures the cost).

**PR-B, the retirement (BREAKING, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, ADR-0087 disposition).**
6. **Remove.**
   - The route, its mount and its ledger row.
   - `packages.adoptOrphans`, `ReassignOrphanedMetadataResponseSchema` (regenerate the five spec baselines in item 1), and the protocol method and facet body.
   - Both UI entries, the dialog and the i18n keys.
   - The `packages_orphan_adoption_unsupported` message key, the three docs pages and the pinned-contract lines (item 4).
   - The `~org` scope: menu row, area mode, Changes row, `isOrgScopeDraft` publish and redirects. Old `/studio/~org/…` URLs redirect to `/studio/~all/metadata/flow?source=loose` (the value's spelling is the card's).
7. **Source badge, if decisions Q-f is answered E (#38061).** After the `~org` removal above, change the Studio list's classification (`studioKindOf`, `ResourceListPage.tsx:763–765`) so an item of a writable authored package reads `new`, using the listed manifests' `writable` flag.
   - This is the classifier change, not a badge-only change. The badge, the source filter (`sourceOf`, 766–768) and prev/next (`useListOrderedNames.ts:187`) move together.
   - Setup's non-Studio list, which reads `row.source`, is left alone.
   - Premise check: no non-test `source=runtime` address remains. Today all of them belong to `~org`: `studioAddressTable.ts:108, 115`, `studioScope.ts:16–17, 42`, `metadataArea.ts:273`, `index.ts:635`.
   - #38061 closes with PR-B.
8. **Tests.** Each removed assertion of item 4's test files names, in the PR, the test on the new door that pins the same assertion at the same or a closer layer (AGENTS.md). Assertions about the old door's own defects are replaced by the three regression tests.
9. **ADR marks (Tier H, so the maintainer merges).**
   - ADR-0084's lines that name `~org` (item 6) lose it.
   - ADR-0070: a dated note that TL;DR item 5's "move these loose items into a base" (line 33) and D5's `offers "move into a base"` (line 87) are this door. D5's "small migration … bulk-assign legacy orphans to a default base" is superseded by ruling 7184753035, and rows never moved stay legal (ADR-0150 D1 bucket 4).
10. **Changeset.** BREAKING, with FROM → TO: `packages.adoptOrphans(id)` and `ReassignOrphanedMetadataResponseSchema` become the move door with an explicit selection, plus its ADR-0087 disposition. `Metadata-protocol: none`.

## Test fixtures and follow-ups

- **Creating a loose item in tests.** After the kernel-close card, no public door creates one. Tests that need a loose row, such as this card's regression and set tests, insert it directly through the engine with the system context, as `packages/qa/dogfood/test/flow-shipped-name-layered-read.dogfood.test.ts:204` does (`store.insert('sys_metadata', …, { context: SYSTEM_CTX })`). This is a test fixture, not a fifth exemption. A test written against a public package-less create would go red when the kernel-close card lands, so write them on the fixture from the start.
- **QA checklist drift.** `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas` still describes `~org`, "Organization flows" and package-less saves: `studio-authoring.json` in 16 places, plus `automation.json`, `access-security.json` and others. Drift does not block a PR (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/README.md:15`), so the PR records one follow-up in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/FOLLOW-UPS.md`, or files a checklist-accuracy card.

## Acceptance

- (PR-A) #37468's three cases are regression tests through the new door, red on main's shape and green here:
  - A1: a move into `com.probe.ghost` answers `422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` and stores nothing;
  - A2: a move of `probe_widget` into namespace `zeta` answers `422 NAMESPACE_PREFIX` and stores nothing;
  - A3: right after a move, `GET /automation/zeta/probe_loose_flow` and `GET /meta/dataset/probe_env_ds?callerPackage=com.probe.zeta` answer `200`, with no restart.
- (PR-A) A set test: a flow alone, when it reads a loose dataset, is refused naming the dataset. Both together succeed.
- (PR-A) One judge test per item-9 judge (child K, owner, permission-set owner, `__c`), each refused with the save door's code.
- (PR-A) A `.custom` pair item and a served overlay are not under "Loose", and the door refuses them.
- (PR-A) The `_env` address after a move is measured on the new door, and the confirm text says what was measured.
- (PR-A, rechecked in PR-B) From the Setup → Packages banner, a person reaches a flow's Loose list in the UI, with no typed address. A package-less flow draft is published from Home's Publish all and from its item page.
- (PR-B, under Q-f E) On `/studio/~all/metadata/flow`, the authored package's flow reads 新建 and a code-shipped flow still reads 系统自带. The Studio filter and prev/next agree with the badge. The test includes an ablation.
- (PR-B) `adopt-orphans` answers `404`. The SDK method, the spec export and the protocol method are gone. These are green: `pnpm check:api-surface` with regenerated baselines, the route-ledger check, and `Type Check UI`. `/studio/~org/…` redirects. Every removed test assertion names its replacement.
- (PR-A) A console walkthrough: filter, select, move, refusal, banner. Screenshots on the PR.
- A contract-review-tier review is recorded for PR-A (widening) and for PR-B (narrowing) before each merges.
- Sequencing: PR-A's server door, schemas and SDK method can be built while #38149 is open; PR-A's UI merges after #38149 (its picker is reused). #37401, #37958 and task 8 also edit `PackagesPage.tsx` and `StudioPackageMenu.tsx`, so merge main after whichever lands first.
